models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.notes: Released Sep 10 2026. Causal encoder-decoder MoE: 552B backbone (763B checkpoint including memory tables), 8B active in prefill and 16B in decode, image input, very small KV cache. No mainstream llama.cpp/MLX runtime yet. Sizes are estimates.

models.name: MiMo V2.6 Flash 309B-A15B
models.notes: Released Sep 21 2026. Omni-modal MoE shipped as native MXFP4 weights (173GB). There are RL and MOPD variants. The community ~2.8-bit GGUF needs ~110GB and targets 128GB machines. The Pro sibling is 1.02T.

models.name: GLM-5.3
models.license: GLM-5.3 License (custom; security review above $10B revenue)
models.notes: Top open coding/agentic model (Aug 28 2026), post-trained on the GLM-5.2 base. Unsloth GGUF sizes: 1-bit 217-228GB, 2-bit 239-254GB, Q4_K_XL 467GB.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash 320B-A18B
models.notes: Released Aug 26 2026. Natively multimodal hybrid sparse/linear-attention MoE. Fits 128GB machines at 1-2 bit (IQ1_S 93GB, UD-Q2_K_XL 109GB). Needs a llama.cpp PR build (#27754).

models.name: Granite 4.2 30B
models.notes: Dense enterprise model released Aug 25 2026, with thinking modes, tool use and RAG. 128K native context, 512K extended.

models.name: Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B
models.notes: Self-improving RL coding/agent MoE released Aug 19 2026, with image input. Also ships 9B (6.6GB) and 397B (242GB). Its benchmark claims have not been reproduced.

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.notes: Best current single-24GB-GPU model (weights out Aug 14 2026). Dense hybrid DeltaNet/attention with thinking, image and video input. 2.8M Ollama pulls. No official 35B-A3B yet.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 125B-A6B
models.notes: 125B MoE plus a 51B n-gram embedding table and a 4B MTP head. Previews the Qwen4 architecture; image input. Unsloth GGUFs: IQ1_S 72.5GB, Q2_K_XL 79GB, IQ4_XS 94GB. The MLX nvfp4 build is 105GB.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Max 2.4T-A95B
models.notes: Rack-scale open flagship; the HF repo is Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B. Unsloth GGUFs: 1-bit 397-564GB, IQ4_XS 1.31TB. Context is 256K native, ~1M extended.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
models.notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/MoE for always-on agents (Aug 11 2026). The small KV cache keeps long context cheap and decode is very fast. The MLX build is 23GB.

models.name: Muse Glimmer 30B
models.notes: Meta's dense local agent model, distilled from Muse Spark, with a 1.8B vision encoder. The DFlash drafter lifts an RTX 5090 from ~75 to ~233 tok/s (NVFP4).

models.name: Kimi K3
models.notes: Largest open-weight model (Jul 27 2026). Native MXFP4, so Q8 (1.56TB) is lossless. Unsloth: 1-bit 466-649GB, 2-bit 551-861GB. Vision.

models.name: Laguna S 2.1 118B-A8B
models.notes: Agentic-coding MoE, mostly sliding-window attention. Ollama q4_K_M is 96GB and nvfp4 is 66GB, so plan on 128GB unified memory.

models.name: Hunyuan Hy3 295B-A21B
models.notes: Full release Jul 6 2026 (preview in Apr). The official 1-bit GGUF (91.8GB) runs on a 128GB Strix Halo at ~24 tok/s with MTP. In mainline llama.cpp since Jul 14 2026.

models.name: Laguna XS 2.1 33B-A3B
models.notes: Local agentic-coding MoE; Poolside recommends 36GB+ RAM. There is a known empty-output issue on macOS in Ollama.

models.name: North Mini Code 1.0 30B-A3B
models.notes: Cohere's first coding model, for agentic SWE and terminal tasks. 64K max output.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B
models.notes: Encoder-free unified multimodal laptop model (Jun 3 2026) with image, audio and video input.

models.name: MiniMax M3
models.notes: Natively multimodal agentic/coding MoE. GGUFs (1-bit 128GB, Q2_K_XL 143GB) are experimental, need a llama.cpp PR build and fall back to dense attention, so long context is costly locally.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B-A55B
models.notes: Hybrid Mamba/LatentMoE flagship (Jun 4 2026) with MTP and an NVFP4 build. Aimed at 8x B200-class servers; local use needs 2-bit quants.

models.name: Command A+ 218B-A25B
models.notes: Enterprise RAG/agent MoE (May 20 2026) with official BF16/FP8/W4A4 builds for vLLM. GGUF support is unconfirmed; sizes are formula estimates.

models.name: Mistral Medium 3.5 128B
models.notes: Dense merged instruct/reasoning/coding flagship with image input. Slow except on big GPUs because all 128B are active.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 1.6T-A49B
models.notes: Native FP4 experts with FP8 elsewhere (~860GB), so ~900GB is the practical floor. Server-class only.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B-A13B
models.notes: Best open model for a single 128GB machine. Unsloth: 1-bit 82-87GB, 2-bit 91-97GB. Native FP4/FP8, so Q8 (162GB) is lossless. Ollama retired its listing on Sep 25 2026.

models.name: Qwen3.6 27B
models.notes: Very popular dense agentic-coding model for 24GB GPUs (Apr 22 2026), with vision, thinking preservation and MTP.

models.name: Kimi K2.6
models.notes: Native INT4 (QAT), so Q8 (595GB) is lossless. The 2-bit GGUF is 340GB. Vision. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.notes: Most-pulled Ollama family of 2026 (6.9M pulls). Fast 3B-active MoE that runs well with experts offloaded to system RAM. Vision.

models.name: MiniMax M2.7
models.license: MiniMax custom (modified MIT; commercial restrictions reported)
models.notes: Agentic/coding MoE for 128GB+ machines: UD-Q2_K_XL 75GB, 1-bit 61GB. API launch was Mar 18 and weights followed Apr 12. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B
models.notes: Dense flagship Gemma, strong at reasoning and coding, with image input. The MLX build is 19GB.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
models.notes: MoE with near-31B quality at ~4B-active speed. The MLX build is 18GB.

models.name: Mistral Small 4 119B-A6.5B
models.notes: 128-expert MoE that unifies Instruct, reasoning and Devstral; image input. 6B active (8B with embeddings). Fits 96-128GB machines at Q4.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B
models.notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/LatentMoE agentic reasoner pretrained in NVFP4 (Mar 11 2026). 1M context; Ollama defaults to 256K.

models.name: Qwen3.5 397B-A17B
models.notes: Qwen's large Apache MoE with vision. UD-IQ1_M is 107GB and 2-bit is 115-123GB, which fit 128-192GB Macs.

models.name: Qwen3.5 122B-A10B
models.notes: Sweet spot for 96-128GB unified memory, with vision. UD-Q2_K_XL is 41.8GB.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B-A3B
models.notes: Agentic coding MoE on the hybrid DeltaNet architecture; very fast for its size. 2.1M Ollama pulls.

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash 30B-A3B
models.notes: Strong local coding/agent MoE for 24-32GB machines. ~2M Ollama pulls.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B
models.notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/MoE reasoning model with a tiny KV cache and 1M context. 868K Ollama pulls. Text only.

models.name: Devstral Small 2 24B
models.notes: Dense agentic coding model for 24GB GPUs or 32GB Macs, with image input. 1.4M Ollama pulls.

models.name: Ministral 3 14B
models.notes: Edge-oriented dense model with vision; fits 12-16GB GPUs.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b
models.notes: Native MXFP4 MoE, so smaller quants make little sense. Fast on 80GB GPUs or 96-128GB unified memory. Adjustable reasoning effort.

notes:
This is the corrected llm-large list as of 2026-09-29: 55 entries, newest first. Sizes are decimal GB. When an ollama_tag is given, q4/q8/fp16 match that tag's download sizes. Otherwise they come from Unsloth GGUF pages (UD-Q4_K_XL or Q4_K_M), or from the formula q4≈0.6P, q8≈1.07P, fp16≈2P. Natively 4-bit models (gpt-oss, Kimi K2.6/K3, DeepSeek V4, MiMo V2.6) have q8 close to q4.

min_runtime_mem_gb is weights plus about 4K of KV cache:
- Up to ~40B: Q4 plus 1-3GB.
- Big MoEs: the smallest common Unsloth dynamic quant (2-bit, or 1-bit IQ1_S above 1T).
- DeepSeek V4 Pro: native FP4 is the floor.
A 1-2 bit fit should be reported as 'runs, degraded / SLOW'.

Decode speed can be estimated as bandwidth ÷ (active params × bytes/param). MoE experts can be offloaded to system RAM (--n-cpu-moe), so check fit against RAM+VRAM.

Runtime caveats:
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has no mainstream llama.cpp/MLX runtime yet.
- GLM-5.3-Flash and MiniMax M3 GGUFs need llama.cpp PR builds.
- Command A+ has no confirmed GGUF.
- Ollama retired deepseek-v4-flash on 2026-09-25.

Deliberately still excluded: GLM-5.2 (Jun 2026, MIT, same base as 5.3), Kimi K2.7 Code, Hunyuan Hy4-preview, MiMo V2.6 Pro 1.02T, Ornith-1.5 397B (242GB), Mistral Large 3 and Devstral 2 123B, Qwen3.5 27B/35B, and older GLM/Kimi/MiniMax versions. Qwen3.8-35B-A3B is only rumoured and was not added.
